segments.sn12.18:1.2: Atha kho timbaruko paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn12.18:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn12.18:2.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha’nti?
segments.sn12.18:2.5: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkha’nti?
segments.sn12.18:2.7: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkha’nti?
segments.sn12.18:2.9: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkha’nti?
segments.sn12.18:2.12: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passatī’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.13: ‘Na khvāhaṃ, timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
segments.sn12.18:3.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.2: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.3: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.4: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.5: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkha’nti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho, timbaruka, natthi sukhadukkhaṃ;
segments.sn12.18:3.7: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na khvāhaṃ, timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
segments.sn12.18:3.10: Ācikkhatu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ.
segments.sn12.18:3.11: Desetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkha”nti.
segments.sn12.18:4.1: “‘Sā vedanā, so vedayatī’ti kho, timbaruka, ādito sato ‘sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha’nti evampāhaṃ na vadāmi.
segments.sn12.18:4.2: ‘Aññā vedanā, añño vedayatī’ti kho, timbaruka, vedanābhitunnassa sato ‘paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkha’nti evampāhaṃ na vadāmi.
segments.sn12.18:4.3: Ete te, timbaruka, ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.sn12.18:5.1: Evaṃ vutte, timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn12.18:5.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.sn12.18:5.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.

lines: Aṭṭhame sā vedanātiādi “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti laddhiyā nisedhanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
“sā vedanā, so vediyatī”ti kho, timbaruka, ādimhiyeva evaṃ sati “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti ayaṃ laddhi hoti.
Evañhi sati vedanāya eva vedanā katā hoti.
Evañca vadanto imissā vedanāya pubbepi atthitaṃ anujānāti, sassataṃ dīpeti sassataṃ gaṇhāti.
Tassa hi taṃ dassanaṃ etaṃ pareti, etaṃ sassataṃ upagacchatīti attho.
Purimañhi atthaṃ sandhāyevetaṃ bhagavatā vuttaṃ bhavissati, tasmā aṭṭhakathāyaṃ taṃ yojetvāvassa attho dīpito.
Evampāhaṃ na vadāmīti ahaṃ “sā vedanā, so vediyatī”ti evampi na vadāmi.
“aññā vedanā añño vediyatī”ti kho, timbaruka, ādimhiyeva evaṃ sati pacchā yā purimapakkhe kārakavedanā, sā ucchinnā.
Tāya pana kataṃ añño vediyatīti evaṃ uppannāya ucchedadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ sampayuttāya vedanāya abhitunnassa sato “paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti ayaṃ laddhi hoti.
Evañca vadanto kārako ucchinno, aññena paṭisandhi gahitāti ucchedaṃ dīpeti, ucchedaṃ gaṇhāti.
Tassa hi taṃ dassanaṃ etaṃ pareti, etaṃ ucchedaṃ upagacchatīti attho.
Idhāpi hi imāni padāni aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āharitvā yojitāneva.
Attāva vedayatī”ti evaṃladdhiko, tasmā tāya laddhiyā “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti vadati, taṃ paṭisaṃharituṃ bhagavā “sā vedanā”tiādiṃ avoca.
Tenāha “sā vedanātiādi sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti laddhiyā nisedhanatthaṃ vutta”nti.
Tatrāti yaṃ vuttaṃ “sā vedanā…pe… sukhadukkha”nti, tasmiṃ pāṭhe.
Yaṃ panettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ anantarasutte vuttameva.
Tattha pana “vedanāto añño attā, vedanāya kārako”ti laddhikassa diṭṭhigatikassa vādo paṭikkhitto, idha “vedanā attā”ti evaṃladdhikassāti ayameva viseso.
Tenāha “evañhi sati vedanāya eva vedanā katā hotī”tiādi.
Yasmā timbaruko “vedanāva attā”ti gaṇhāti, tasmā vuttaṃ “ahaṃ sā vedanā…pe… na vadāmī”ti.
Aññā vedanātiādīsupi yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ anantarasutte vuttanayameva.
